semiconductor_relevance: High — Precitec Optronik GmbH specializes in precision measurement solutions that are critical for various stages of semiconductor production.
summary: Precitec Optronik GmbH is a German manufacturer of advanced sensors and optical probes, providing high-precision, non-contact measurement solutions for the semiconductor industry. Their CHRocodile© product line is designed for contact-free thickness and distance measurements, enabling fast and accurate inspection processes from wafer production to device packaging.
capabilities: Thickness and distance measurement across various materials

regional_presence.Germany: Precitec Optronik GmbH is based in Germany, focusing on innovative sensor solutions for various industries including semiconductor.
